description: This file defines API routes for a subtitle synchronization service using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for uploading video and subtitle files, initiating the sync process, and retrieving sync results. It handles request validation, interacts with processing functions, and manages file paths and responses.

classes.name: SyncResponse
classes.description: Response model containing details of the subtitle sync result, such as file path, format, shift, entries, etc.

classes.name: SyncJobResult
classes.description: Wrapper model containing job ID and the SyncResponse, representing a synchronization job result.

classes.name: DownloadResponse
classes.description: Response model providing info about the location and existence of the synced subtitle for download.

methods.name: SyncJobResult sync_subtitles( video: UploadFile = File(..., description="Video file containing the audio."), subtitle: UploadFile = File(..., description="Subtitle file (.srt, .vtt, .ass, .ssa)."), prefer_whisper: bool = Form(False, description="Use Whisper if available, otherwise stub."), whisper_model: str = Form("base", description="Whisper model name if prefer_whisper is true."), )
methods.description: Endpoint to upload video and subtitle, perform synchronization, and return job details.

methods.name: DownloadResponse get_download_info(job_id: str)
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve file path and existence info for a completed sync job.
